- `apps/web/modules/users/views/users-public-view.tsx` (calls `useIsEmbed(props.isEmbed)`)
- `apps/web/modules/shell/TopNav.tsx`
- `apps/web/modules/shell/navigation/Navigation.tsx`
- `apps/web/modules/bookings/views/bookings-single-view.tsx`
- `apps/web/modules/bookings/components/BookerWebWrapper.tsx`
- `apps/web/modules/bookings/components/event-meta/Duration.tsx`
- `apps/web/modules/bookings/components/event-meta/Members.tsx`
- `apps/web/app/(use-page-wrapper)/payment/[uid]/PaymentPage.tsx`

- `apps/web/modules/test-setup.ts` stubs it with `vi.fn()` in the shared test setup.
